review_response_tasks.stem: My uncle's job is driving a bus. He is a ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：singer是歌手，不是以驾驶巴士为工作的职业。；B：writer是作家，不是该工作名称。；C：driver是驾驶员，符合题面定义。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our meal plan says: “Dinner 18:30.” At 18:30, we have ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：给定安排是晚餐，不是早餐。；B：与本题提供的Dinner 18:30相符。；C：与给定晚餐安排不符。

review_response_tasks.stem: The museum rule says “No photos inside.” Inside, we must not ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：直接违反明确给出的No photos规定。；B：读标签不是该条规定禁止的拍照行为。；C：安静走动不是该条规定禁止的拍照行为。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our team needs white shirts, not white hats or blue shirts. We choose the ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：虽为白色，但帽子不是衬衫。；B：衬衫类别对，蓝色不符。；C：衣物类别和颜色都符合要求。

review_response_tasks.stem: Brush A has a “Clean” label; brush B has a “Dirty” label. A is ____, but B is ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：将题面两标签对应关系反转。；B：A为Clean、B为Dirty，逐项符合。；C：B为Dirty，不是Clean。

review_response_tasks.stem: This card has my name and lets me borrow books from our library. It is a ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：姓名及在本图书馆借书功能符合图书卡。；B：巴士票不授权从图书馆借书。；C：护照不是本图书馆借书卡。

review_response_tasks.stem: To remove the pencil marks, I use a soft rubber tool: an ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：ruler为尺，和软橡胶擦除工具的定义不同。；B：scissors为剪刀，不是橡胶擦除工具。；C：eraser是擦除铅笔痕迹的橡皮，符合定义及an。

review_response_tasks.stem: We ____ three photos in the museum garden yesterday.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：yesterday明确过去时间，原形take不合。；B：took为take的过去式，符合本句。；C：无助动词时不能单用taking作谓语。

review_response_tasks.stem: At our toy exchange, we give one toy and keep another, without paying. We ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：题面互换并保留另一玩具，就是交换玩具。；B：明确不付钱，不是购买。；C：没有修理操作，不能以repair概括互换。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our paper bird has black wings and white feet. Its feet are ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：黑色描述的是翅膀，不是脚。；B：题面未给棕色，脚明确为white。；C：直接符合作者纸鸟的脚色，不当真实物种事实。
